analysis_run_ai_snapshot_check.name: analysis_run_ai_snapshot_check
analysis_run_ai_snapshot_check.value: ("analysis_run"."ai_provider" is null and "analysis_run"."model_id" is null and "analysis_run"."prompt_bundle_version" is null and "analysis_run"."category_snapshot" is null) or ("analysis_run"."ai_provider" is not null and "analysis_run"."model_id" is not null and "analysis_run"."prompt_bundle_version" is not null and "analysis_run"."category_snapshot" is not null and json_valid("analysis_run"."category_snapshot"))

analysis_run_completion_check.name: analysis_run_completion_check
analysis_run_completion_check.value: ("analysis_run"."status" not in ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED')) or "analysis_run"."completed_at" is not null

analysis_run_success_artifact_check.name: analysis_run_success_artifact_check
analysis_run_success_artifact_check.value: "analysis_run"."status" <> 'SUCCEEDED' or ("analysis_run"."document_artifact_key" is not null and "analysis_run"."page_count" is not null and "analysis_run"."character_count" is not null)

analysis_run_failure_error_check.name: analysis_run_failure_error_check
analysis_run_failure_error_check.value: "analysis_run"."status" <> 'FAILED' or ("analysis_run"."error_code" is not null and "analysis_run"."error_message" is not null)

similarity_pair_mode_semantic_check.name: similarity_pair_mode_semantic_check
similarity_pair_mode_semantic_check.value: ("similarity_pair"."mode" = 'LEXICAL_ONLY' and "similarity_pair"."semantic_score" is null) or ("similarity_pair"."mode" = 'HYBRID' and "similarity_pair"."semantic_score" is not null)
